question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: Lipi was once at risk of being married off by her father due to (a) ------- hardship. Though she wanted to continue her education, her parents had arranged her marriage with Tara Mia, a wealthy but (b) ------- widower from the same village. Lipi, determined to stop the marriage, sought help from her classmates and the Headteacher. A meeting was called, where the teacher explained that early marriage could cause serious (c) ------- problems and end her education. Most people present at the meeting (d) ------- the Headteacher’s view and the marriage was cancelled. Now Lipi is pursuing higher studies at Carmichael College and working toward her (e) -------. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) financial; (b) illiterate; (c) health; (d) supported; (e) dream; ● st ●
